C0874.title: Lanzhou University Server Infected with Cryptomining Malware and Lateral Spread
C0874.summary: In May 2026, a university server in Lanzhou was remotely implanted with cryptomining malware. Due to the lack of internal network segmentation, the malware rapidly spread to other office devices, creating serious security risks. The university was administratively penalized and ordered to rectify for failing to fulfill its cybersecurity protection obligations.
